kit.doc: /** 🧰️ The shared brepjs test kit: the destructured vitest, the brepjs kernel dependencies and the bootstrapped cad modules. */
kit.name: createBrepjsTestKit
kit.fdoc: Creates the shared brepjs test kit of one registration from the injected dependencies.

groups.doc: /** 🧱️ The cad-js brepjs describe block: its wrapper, kernel fixture and parts. */
groups.name: registerBrepjsSuite
groups.fdoc: Registers the cad-js brepjs describe block from its kernel fixture and parts.

helpers.doc: /** 🛠️ The brepjs kernel fixture shared by the brepjs parts. */
helpers.name: createBrepjsKernelHelpers
helpers.fdoc: Creates the brepjs kernel fixture shared by the brepjs parts.

parts.doc: /** 📦️ The brepjs box volume, tessellation, solid sync and extrude tests. */
parts.name: registerBoxAndExtrudeTests
parts.fdoc: Registers the box volume, tessellate, solid sync, extrude wire diff and extrude curve command tests.

parts.doc: /** 🕸️ The brepjs sheared shell sync, tessellation cache and dispose tests. */
parts.name: registerTessellationCacheTests
parts.fdoc: Registers the sheared shell sync, face entity mapping, cached mesh, dispose and face bucket tests.

parts.doc: /** 📐️ The brepjs topology preview, aabb, measure and adjacency tests. */
parts.name: registerTopologyAndMeasureTests
parts.fdoc: Registers the topology preview, moved shell aabb, distance, area, volume, hull fuse, adjacency and aabb difference tests.

parts.doc: /** 〰️ The brepjs arc, circle, sphere, control point, interpolate, typology and fixture roundtrip tests. */
parts.name: registerCurveCommandTests
parts.fdoc: Registers the arc, circle, sphere, control point curve, worker argument, interpolate curve, typology and concrete forest fixture tests.
